/*selectprojectList*/ SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS ADD_DATE, BURQ_NO, PROJECT_NAME, (SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = PROJECT_MNG_USER) AS PM_NAME, PROJECT_UNIT, PROJECT_MNG_USER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'BURQ02' AND PROJECT_STATUS = CODE) AS PROJECT_STAUTS_TEXT FROM KEP_BURQ_MNG WHERE TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date} AND PROJECT_STATUS <> 'G'
AND PROJECT_STATUS <> 'G'
AND UPPER(PROJECT_NAME) LIKE UPPER('%'||#{st_project_name}||'%')
ORDER BY BURQ_NO
